one_off_receipts.what: Upfront consideration received from Elevar under the lirafugratinib licence agreement (entered December 2024)
one_off_receipts.quote: As of March 31, 2025, we had received $5.0 million in upfront consideration and $2.7 million in conjunction with the transfer of active pharmaceutical ingredient and other materials from Elevar pursuant to the Elevar Agreement.
